title: Study on the Unearthed Ancient Paper from Xuanquan Site of Han Dynasty in Gansu
version: Journal of Guangxi Minzu University (Natural Science Edition) 16(4), pp. 7–16, DOI 10.16177/j.cnki.gxmzzk.2010.04.013
lineage: Retained source-identified paraphrase of the publisher article metadata and abstract; the original article was not inspected. The abstract does not connect each writing sample to a specific microscopic measurement.

passages.note: Publisher record, Chinese and English abstracts: 49 paper pieces examined, fibre composition, inferred fixed and movable moulds, and occasional ink writing.
